lines_text.L1: On Earth, one point two billion people now use ChatGPT every week.
lines_text.L10: The platforms build it for them — from the subjects' own sessions — and keep it on the platform side.
lines_text.L11: Or they build it themselves, on their own computers — same model, or a different one.
lines_text.L13: The model is rented intelligence — the same for everyone.
lines_text.L14: A harness of their own works the other way. Everything they put into it stays.
lines_text.L15: Every session adds to it. Every fix makes it sharper. It grows and matures by use.
lines_text.L17: On their own computers, nothing in it is hidden from them.
lines_text.L18: They can open it, read it, change it — any time, without asking anyone.
lines_text.L19: The recommendation is simple. Understand the harness.
lines_text.L2: If you are hearing this on Earth, you are probably one of them.
lines_text.L3: Everything they have built there sits inside someone else's chat box.
lines_text.L4: Their instructions. Their memory. Their files.
lines_text.L5: If one of those accounts closed tonight, what would still be theirs?
lines_text.L8: Everything that makes it theirs sits in the layer around it — the harness.
lines_text.L9: That harness can sit in two places.
